items.title: Super Micro Computer (SMCI) Joins A Major Enterprise AI Infrastructure Build

The company’s systems will be integrated into Cisco’s Secure AI Factory architecture, which uses NVIDIA technologies for enterprise, neocloud and sovereign cloud customers.
